tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Paper: warm off-white drafting paper. Blueprint: deep navy-black night sheet.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, the HUD strip: one step lifted off `paper`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Code blocks, wells, simulator log, table stripes: one step pressed into `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and every drawing line, on `paper`, `surface` and `surface-sunk` (14.6:1 or better in both themes). Primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels, on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunk` (6.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: table rules, dividers, grid inside cards. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, buttons, checkboxes, toggles) and drawing outlines. Same as `ink`.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Drafting grid lines and crosshair marks in heroes and simulator canvases only. Never behind lesson text.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, the italic headline word, selected state, focus ring, live dots. Text on `paper`/`surface` 5.2:1+ (Paper), 6.5:1+ (Blueprint); on `surface-sunk` 4.6:1 (Paper).

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `cobalt` fill (5.9:1 Paper, 7.1:1 Blueprint).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 5.2:1+ on `paper` in both themes.

tokens.name: phase-1
tokens.usage: Phase 1 (Foundations & Networking) layer color: sage. Fills for phase squares, iso plates, progress bars and chart series. Always with its number or name; carry text in `on-phase-1`.

tokens.name: phase-2
tokens.usage: Phase 2 (APIs, Databases, Storage & Search) layer color: lime. Fills for phase squares, iso plates, progress bars and chart series. Always with its number or name; carry text in `on-phase-2`.

tokens.name: phase-3
tokens.usage: Phase 3 (Caching & Messaging) layer color: coral. Fills for phase squares, iso plates, progress bars and chart series. Always with its number or name; carry text in `on-phase-3`.

tokens.name: phase-4
tokens.usage: Phase 4 (Distributed Systems & Reliability) layer color: plum. Fills for phase squares, iso plates, progress bars and chart series. Always with its number or name; carry text in `on-phase-4`.

tokens.name: phase-5
tokens.usage: Phase 5 (Observability, Security, Deployment) layer color: lavender. Fills for phase squares, iso plates, progress bars and chart series. Always with its number or name; carry text in `on-phase-5`.

tokens.name: phase-6
tokens.usage: Phase 6 (Advanced & AI-Native Systems) layer color: cobalt. Fills for phase squares, iso plates, progress bars and chart series. Always with its number or name; carry text in `on-phase-6`.

tokens.name: phase-7
tokens.usage: Phase 7 (Interview Mastery) layer color: charcoal. Fills for phase squares, iso plates, progress bars and chart series. Always with its number or name; carry text in `on-phase-7`.

tokens.name: on-phase-1
tokens.usage: Numbers and labels on a `phase-1` fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-phase-2
tokens.usage: Numbers and labels on a `phase-2` fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-phase-3
tokens.usage: Numbers and labels on a `phase-3` fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-phase-4
tokens.usage: Numbers and labels on a `phase-4` fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-phase-5
tokens.usage: Numbers and labels on a `phase-5` fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-phase-6
tokens.usage: Numbers and labels on a `phase-6` fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-phase-7
tokens.usage: Numbers and labels on a `phase-7` fill (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: OK label text and glyph (●) on `paper`/`surface`/`surface-sunk`; 5.0:1+ Paper, 10:1+ Blueprint.

tokens.name: status-ok-fill
tokens.usage: OK chip / node fill. Text on it is `ink` (11.4:1 Paper, 6.8:1 Blueprint).

tokens.name: status-hot
tokens.usage: Hot label text and glyph (▲) on `paper`/`surface`/`surface-sunk`; 4.6:1+ Paper, 10:1+ Blueprint.

tokens.name: status-hot-fill
tokens.usage: Hot chip / node fill. Text on it is `ink` (11.2:1 Paper, 6.8:1 Blueprint).

tokens.name: status-over
tokens.usage: Overloaded label text and glyph (■) on `paper`/`surface`/`surface-sunk`; 4.8:1+ Paper, 7.7:1+ Blueprint. Also error text.

tokens.name: status-over-fill
tokens.usage: Overloaded chip / node fill and incorrect-answer fill. Text on it is `ink` (7.7:1 Paper, 8.3:1 Blueprint).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero only. One per page. Wraps in 2–3 lines.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Lesson section titles and landing section titles.

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: Exactly one word per headline, in `cobalt`, set at the headline's size. Never body text, never two words.

styles.name: body-lesson
styles.sample: A follower that applies writes late can serve a read that misses the user's own update.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: App UI copy, card text, panel text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in UI copy and button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, footnotes, tooltips with sentences.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Labels, table headers, tabs, tool buttons, spec labels.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Figure captions, HUD, axis ticks, stamps.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Code, event log lines, REPL. Sentence case.

styles.name: mono-metric
styles.usage: Live numbers: QPS, p99, scores. Tabular figures. Units in `mono-caption` beside it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, stamp padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; tool button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gutter between controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; HUD item gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding inside panels; drafting grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, HUD, drafting frames, phase squares: true right angles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes, stamps, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callout boxes, flashcards, code blocks. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Numbered callout circles and live dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow for raised cards, hovered primary buttons and the flashcard. Never blur.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels and the Design Studio palette only.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything else: borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Table rules, dividers, card outlines.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Control borders, buttons, stamps, iso plate outlines.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Parts-list top rule, selected quiz option, active tab.
